title: Kya tumhara dhyan bhi 20 minute padhte hi bhatakne lagta hai? Brain continuous attention se exhaustion mode me chala jata hai. Aaj 25 minute ka ek strict timer lagao aur mobile door rakh do. Pehla slot khatam karke niche DONE likho.

Baar baar book re-read karke lagta hai sab yaad ho gaya? Yeh sirf familiarity hai, real memory active retrieval se banti hai. Book band karo aur ek blank paper par sab recall karke likho. Try this now and comment DONE.

Din raat padhne ke baad bhi mock test me marks nahi aa rahe? Problem tumhari memory nahi tumhara passive revision format hai. Aaj se wrong questions ka error log banao aur unhe firse solve karo. Error log banaya toh comment DONE karo.

Mobile side rakho aur 10 second tak sirf apni book ko dekho. Apka dimaag padhai se nahi, padhai start karne ke effort se darta hai. Bas pehla page kholo aur sirf do lines padho, baaki momentum sambhaal lega. Try karo aur comment mein DONE likho.
